channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Rahm Emanuel Says Bessent's Rhetoric Overshoots His Actions
item.description: Rahm Emanuel, who served as Ambassador to Japan under President Obama, said that Scott Bessent's rhetoric around the economy and the US backing of the Japanese Yen is 'harder than his action' and 'overshoots' his capacity to deliver. Emanuel also discussed the midterm elections and said that the American people will see through Trump's $5,000 dividend 'gimmick.' (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Americans Will See Right Through Trump's $5,000 Offer, Rahm Emanuel Says
item.description: Rahm Emanuel, former White House chief of staff and former US ambassador to Japan, reacts to President Donald Trump’s proposal of a $5,000 payment tied to a Republican win in the midterms, saying "this dog won't hunt." Emanuel argues that both President Trump and Democrats want the election to be a referendum on Trump, but said Republicans are framing it as a test of Trump’s record and leadership. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rep. Jordan Backs Trump's $5,000 Dividend Plan
item.description: US Rep. Jim Jordan, a Republican from Ohio, and a close ally of President Donald Trump, supports Trump's plan to give US adults a payment of $5,000. But Jordan says he would like to see more details. He also says Republicans will keep their majority in Congress after the midterms. He speaks on "Balance of Power" from Dallas. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Canada Targets Millions of Drones, With a Third for Ukraine
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy signed a declaration of a 100-year partnership between their two countries, as Canada pledged to boost its drone production capacity and send one-third to Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Nojoud Al Mallees, Iain Boekhoff and Aliaksandr Kudrytski

item.title: Brazil Election: Bolsonaro Surges in Poll as Supreme Court Crisis Weighs on Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro surged into a tie with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a new poll, erasing a 4.5-point gap as a crisis inside Brazil’s Supreme Court weighs on the leftist leader’s reelection bid.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Diniz Tavares

item.title: Trump's $5,000 Dividend Offer Is a Gimmick, Says Beto O'Rourke
item.description: Beto O’Rourke said President Donald Trump’s promise to pay American adults $5,000 apiece is a "gimmick" and will never be paid. The former US representative from Texas says Republicans can't offer voters real change. He also talks about how Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico can win his race in Texas. O'Rourke speaks to Bloomberg's Julie Fine and Kailey Leinz in Dallas. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Peru to Join Trump’s Shield of the Americas Security Coalition
item.description: Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori said her country will join the Shield of the Americas, a US-led security coalition intended to fight drug cartels across the region.
item.dc:creator: Eric Martin and Katherine Pennacchio

item.title: Talarico Calls on Paxton to Address Epstein Survivors’ Demands
item.description: Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico appeared in Dallas Thursday with a group of Jeffrey Epstein survivors, accusing his Republican opponent, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, of ignoring their push for greater transparency about the disgraced financier and sex offender.
item.dc:creator: Catherine Lucey

item.title: Supreme Court Weighs US Mail Ballot Fight as DOJ Losses Grow
item.description: A federal appeals court has denied the Trump administration’s request to let the US Postal Service enforce new restrictions for mail-in ballots, handing the Justice Department another setback as it urges the Supreme Court to intervene ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Tillman

item.title: Tina Fordham on Iran, AI and the Geopolitics Supercycle
item.description:
Tina Fordham, Founder & Chief Geostrategist at Fordham Global Foresight, joins to discuss her new book, 'Mad World: A Geostrategy Survival Guide for Leaders,' and why she believes the world has entered a “geopolitics supercycle.” Fordham argues that geopolitical disruption is becoming a structural feature of the global economy, driven by conflict, cyberattacks, tariffs, sanctions and climate-related shocks rather than a temporary period of instability.
Fordham also examines what the changing global order means for markets, CEOs and investors, including the evolving U.S. role in global security and trade, the war with Iran, elevated energy prices and risks surrounding strategic shipping chokepoints. She explains why business leaders need to balance the opportunities created by AI and technological innovation with a volatile geopolitical landscape.
Fordham speaks with Lisa Mateo and Paul Sweeney on Bloomberg Surveillance. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Beto O’Rourke Says Trump Payouts ‘Stink of Desperation’
item.description: President Donald Trump’s promise to pay American adults $5,000 apiece if Republicans maintain control of Congress underscores his fear about the midterm elections in November, said Beto O’Rourke, a prominent Texas Democrat.
item.dc:creator: Joe Lovinger and Erik Wasson

item.title: Scrutiny of Spain’s Sánchez Grows With Release of Ceuta Papers
item.description: Pedro Sánchez had hoped to draw a line under his government’s handling of the migration crisis in Ceuta by declassifying documents late last night. Instead, it’s had the opposite effect.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Basteiro

item.title: UAE Plans to Invest $46 Billion in Germany From AI to Energy
item.description: The United Arab Emirates plans to invest €40 billion ($46 billion) in Germany in sectors ranging from AI to energy and defense, as the Gulf country looks to deepen strategic partnerships across Europe.
item.dc:creator: Alex Dooler, Abeer Abu Omar and Arne Delfs

item.title: Key Takeaways From the GOP’s Midterm Convention in Dallas
item.description: Trump asked supporters to consider November’s midterm elections a referendum on his presidency, while acknowledging it may take voters time to feel the benefits of his policies. Kailey Leinz has more from the GOP’s midterm convention in Dallas. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: JD Vance’s Republican Midterm Convention Speech to Spotlight 2028 Race
item.description: Donald Trump headed to Dallas looking for a rebound in Republican fortunes. JD Vance’s future likely hinges on it.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove

item.title: Thune Says ‘Good Question’ on Trump’s $5,000 Payout to US Adults
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune declined to answer a question on whether the Republican-controlled Senate would pass President Donald Trump’s proposal to give each US adult a $5,000 payment.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis, María Paula Mijares Torres and Caitlin Reilly

item.title: Trump Promises $500 Refunds for Obamacare Plans Republicans Cut
item.description: The Trump administration pledged to send $500 each to nearly 1 million Americans it said paid too much for federally backed Obamacare health insurance, whose funding was at the center of a political standoff that led to last year’s record-long government shutdown.
item.dc:creator: Ike Swetlitz and Melos Ambaye

item.title: US Supreme Court Blocks Missouri GOP-Backed Voting Map Again
item.description: The US Supreme Court blocked Missouri from using a congressional map engineered by GOP lawmakers in the midterm elections, appearing to resolve a multifaceted legal fight that had cast uncertainty over how districts will be drawn for the November vote.
item.dc:creator: Madlin Mekelburg

item.title: Algeria Cuts Diplomatic Ties With UAE, Citing ‘Hostile’ Acts
item.description: Algeria said it decided to sever diplomatic relations with the United Arab Emirates after exhausting “all available avenues” for maintaining ties.
item.dc:creator: Salah Slimani and Tarek El-Tablawy

item.title: Trump Bet on Latino Vote Shows Signs of Backfiring in Texas
item.description: New congressional map makes state a key battleground
item.dc:creator: Joe Lovinger
